authorization: On 6 September 2026 the user explicitly requested Katz–Tao and other published results as custom axioms. This supersedes the earlier no-custom-axioms preference; the manuscript’s new arguments are not authorized as published inputs.
predicate: For every fixed MeasurableNormalization and eps>0 there exists c>0, before all MeasurableConfiguration n geom (n-1), such that c*delta^(2*n-1-d+eps)*lambda^d*M <= volume.real unionSet. The record still carries cap hypotheses; its cap coefficient is absent from the bound.

axioms.name: KakeyaFormal.ExternalAxioms.wolff1995
axioms.source_locator: Wolff (1995), Theorem 1, printed p. 652; includes the already known n=2 case described there.
axioms.trust_boundary: Trusted normalized restricted-shading corollary of the cited published maximal estimate, including the mathematical translation from operator estimates via testing/Hölder and direction packing, fixed separation coefficients, projective versus angular metrics, closed capsule versus cylinder carriers, tube-volume normalization, and extension to 0<delta<=1. These source-to-predicate translations are assumed rather than kernel-proved here. The inverse-cap-coefficient weakening and measurable-to-grid adapter are proved. No fractional-cap, larger-ambient or manuscript generalized pivot result is assumed.
